customers.evidence: The people we serve are at the heart of everything we do.

employees.evidence: Our associates have deep home improvement experience and training

shareholders.evidence: To deliver on our mission and drive market share acceleration, we launched our Total Home Strategy.

result.analyst_notes: Customer-first, absolute framing: 'at the heart of everything we do' and 'Every aspect of our business' leave no hedging. First-person plural voice. Business-volume figures and strategy pillars dominate, with market share as the main growth goal. Workforce appears only as expertise, and values like safety, sustainability and ethics are absent.
